messages:
viv: Heads-up: promote for release/3.1.0 is blocked. Artifact verification failing: linux-amd64 and linux-arm64 builds of redwood-agent produce different checksums and SBOM signature verification fails.

ci-bot: Postsubmit artifact-verify failed: build/artifact-verify (exit 1) https://ci.internal/runs/110999 :x:

viv: Verify step error: manifest verify mismatch: wrote manifest with checksum a1b2... for amd64 but arm64 uploaded b3c4... SBOM signing refused (signature mismatch). Only one arch needs to match for promotion but our policy requires consistent multi-arch manifest.

omar: This looks like the Go linker adding a build-id or timestamp that differs between runners. We changed the linker flags in #4899 to speed builds; maybe that opened non-determinism.

lee: Deploy-bot paused promotion due to artifact verify: :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/3.1.0 by CI gate (artifact verification failed). I will resume when artifact-verify passes for all arches.

rachel: Options: 1) force single-arch promote (not allowed per policy) 2) pin to previous multi-arch manifest and re-run verify 3) make builds reproducible by stripping build-id / setting SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and re-run 4) revert the linker change and rebuild.

omar: Quickest safe fix is to add deterministic linker flags to the build step: `-ldflags='-buildid='` and set `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct)` so timestamps are deterministic. I'll open a small patch to the build matrix and re-run.

lee: Also add a step to the multi-arch publish process that normalizes ELF .note.gnu.build-id or at least strips it before checksum calculation. That prevents minor metadata drift.

sbom-bot: SBOM signing policy: all artifact layers in a multi-arch manifest must match expected digests. Non-deterministic metadata will cause reject until fixed.

viv: I'll push the patch with deterministic linker flags. Command:
```
git checkout -b fix/reproducible-builds
yq -i '.build.go.ldflags = "-ldflags=\\\"-buildid= -s -w\\\""' ci/build.yml
export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct)
git commit -am "make go builds deterministic for multi-arch manifests (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH + strip build-id)"
git push origin fix/reproducible-builds
```

ci-bot: Manual rerun link: https://ci.internal/manual/110999?action=rerun

omar: If that doesn't clear it, we'll fallback to pinning the manifest to the previous release and rerunning the build in a single, hermetic cross-compile environment (longer).

ci-bot: Rerun started; building amd64/arm64 with reproducible flags.

ci-bot: Rerun result: amd64 and arm64 binaries now produce matching checksums at 1770000500. SBOM signing accepted.

rachel: Nice. deploy-bot resuming promotion. Canary images pushed and multi-arch manifest published.

lee: Action items: omar -> follow-up PR to add ELF-normalize step in publish pipeline (INFRA-1333), rachel -> add release-note explaining temporary linker normalization (doc-only), viv -> close this thread after monitoring.

viv: Release note draft: "Temporarily normalized Go linker metadata to ensure reproducible multi-arch artifacts; follow-up INFRA-1333 to add automatic ELF metadata normalization in the publish pipeline."

omar: Also scheduling a test to simulate cross-arch runner differences so we catch this earlier.

viv: update 1770000600: promotion resumed, canary deployed to eu-west-2. Leaving monitoring window open for 1h. Closing provisional hold for change window.

rachel: Thanks all — will update the changelog and tracking ticket. :white_check_mark:
